subject: Urgent: Unusual sign-in activity on your Chase Online account
body:
Dear Chase Customer,

We detected a sign-in attempt from an unrecognized IP address (Moscow, Russia). For your security, your account access has been temporarily restricted.

To restore full account functionality, please verify your identity immediately at our secure portal:
https://chase-identity-resolution.net/auth/login

Failure to verify within 24 hours will result in permanent suspension of online banking.

Sincerely,
Chase Security Operations

subject: DHL Express: Delivery failure notice - Parcel #DHL-782910
body:
Dear Recipient,

Your package arrived at our sorting facility with incomplete shipping paperwork. An unpaid customs clearance fee of $3.50 is required before dispatch.

Pay clearance fee and download re-delivery receipt here:
http://dhl-shipping-clearance.info/pay

If unpaid within 48 hours, shipment will be destroyed per maritime customs regulations.
